text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking near the park with Vodka,
we heard Daiwa Scarlet's voice.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey! How many times do I have to tell you
not to grab my tail... Geez!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...?
What's Scarlet squirming around like that for?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Yay, yay!
Such a fluffy tail!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Come on, stop grabbing me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... Geez~~...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Scarlet!
Looks like you're having fun dealing with those little brats.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Haaaah?! Hey, Vodka, are you making fun of me?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If this looks fun to you,
I'll gladly trade places anytime...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I'd feel bad interrupting while you're all having fun together,
so I'll pass.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer, shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey!
Are you planning to leave me behind all alone!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I don't mind helping you out, but you'll owe me one, got it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
U-Uuu... Why do I have to end up
owing you a favor?!
choice_data_list: Why don't you go help them?
Why don't you go help them?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~?
Sheesh... You're way too soft on me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, I get it. All I gotta do is help out, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you guys!
Don't give the miss over there a hard time.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna mess around that badly,
I'll be your opponent next time.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Really?
Yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: F-Finally free... I'm totally exhausted...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Geez, completely wiped out from just this much?
Have you been slacking off on your training?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No way in the world!!
These little ones are just a bit too energetic...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's just how kids are.
You've gotta give 'em your all, so if you've only got ordinary stamina—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hm? Full power...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I see, Trainer!
This might actually make for great training.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer.
Isn't there some game we can play that doubles as training?
choice_data_list: Tag is the obvious choice here!
Tag is the obvious choice here!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer.
Isn't there some game we can play that doubles as training?
choice_data_list: Tag is the obvious choice here!
Tag is the obvious choice here!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Tag, huh!
Sounds good! Running is the foundation, after all!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe,
wonder if the brats can keep up with my speed?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Let's see...
First off, Scarlet's "it"!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a second! Why do I have
to participate in this too?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you're pretty much the only one
who can catch me, right, Scarlet?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That's true... Wait, hey!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Then
YOU should just be the demon, you jerk~!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Come on, everyone,
run away from Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Waaah!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey!
Wait up!

And so, a game of tag set
in the park began.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah—!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Man... running around this much
is really... catching up to my lungs!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah... Why do I have to...
play tag of all things...?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you say that, but you were
chasing after it dead seriously, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: U-Um, t-that's...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Haha! Come on now, don't be so stubborn!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Still, don't you think it feels nice to run around like we used to when we were kids every once in a while?"

Vodka asked with an expression
that looked unusually satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"A jungle gym?
Heh, not bad!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Alright then, I'm gonna be first to the top!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, big sister, that's not fair!
Wait up!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, if you're mad about it,
try beating me to the top!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Don't go stooping to a kid's level
and competing with them.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The hell did you say!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm just telling the truth.
You're childish in every single way!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what would you do
if your opponent went easy on you in a race?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
With that look on your face, like you could easily win
without even taking running seriously.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"That's an insult to me.
I won't let them get away with it."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Right?
Even those brats are the same way.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Kids sure as hell don't like it
when you treat 'em like they're just kids and brush 'em off.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"When the opponent is giving it their all,
there's no way in hell I'd pull something lame like holding back."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —And with that, I'm off! Ain't no way I'm letting anyone take the top spot!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I am definitely gonna be sore tomorrow.
My arms and legs are completely swollen.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "...Wait, what is it, Scarlet?Are you gonna call me childish again?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...I'm amazed.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The hell did you say?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Save giving your all
for when you run against me—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No matter what I say,
you won't listen anyway, will you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, damn straight.
Naturally, I'm gonna go all out to crush you too!

No matter who her opponent is going forward,
Vodka will surely continue to challenge them with all her might.
